text: Ships with OpenCode and Claude Code as built-in terminal AI coding agents for developers
quote: Omarchy ships with OpenCode and Claude Code as the default agent harnesses for programmers.

text: Provides a menu to set up preconfigured development environments for various languages/frameworks
quote: Omarchy supports setting up a whole host of development environments through the Install > Development section of the Omarchy Menu

text: Config setup is designed to be easily readable/editable by an AI agent for customization tasks
quote: This is particularly helpful when you're having an AI agent work with you on customization or configuration.

text: Includes Lazygit, a terminal-based Git client alternative to GUI tools like GitHub Desktop
quote: Lazygit is a delightful alternative to something like the GitHub Desktop application, and it runs inside the terminal.

text: Includes a CLI tool (fip) to forward remote ports to localhost over SSH
quote: fip: Forward one or more ports from a remote host to localhost via SSH.

text: Entire system can be operated purely via keyboard shortcuts
quote: Everything in Omarchy happens via the keyboard — EVERYTHING!

text: Comes with nineteen built-in visual themes selectable from a menu
quote: Omarchy comes with nineteen beautiful themes. You can select between them via Style > Theme in the Omarchy Menu

text: Includes Aether, a GUI app for creating custom themes with color and background pickers
quote: You can also use the included Aether application to create a new theme using a lovely GUI interface to play with colors and search for backgrounds.

text: Unified clipboard history for text and images accessible via a hotkey (Walker)
quote: The clipboard history is provided by Walker and works for both text and images. You trigger it by Super + Ctrl + V

text: System-wide AI dictation feature (Voxtype) triggered by hotkey or hold-to-talk key
quote: Omarchy offers AI dictation via Voxtype. ... you dictate by holding down F9 or by toggling with Super + Ctrl + X

text: Automatically creates system snapshots on every update, with manual snapshot creation also supported
quote: We create snapshots automatically on every Omarchy update, but should you want to create your own, you can use omarchy-snapshot create.

text: Can run a full Windows environment in an isolated Docker VM for apps unavailable on Linux
quote: Omarchy offers an easy way to run Windows through a Docker VM. ... The VM does not have access to any other files on your system, so you're safe from malware or viruses on the Linux side.

text: Supports installing Omarchy on a single partition alongside Windows or other OSes (dual boot)
quote: In Omarchy Quattro, you're able to install Omarchy to a single partition alongside Windows or other installations.

text: Full-disk encryption is enabled by default on installation
quote: Full-disk encryption is mandatory ... Firewall is enabled by default: All incoming traffic by default except for port 22 for ssh and port 53317 for LocalSend.

text: Firewall is enabled by default, blocking all incoming traffic except SSH and LocalSend ports
quote: Full-disk encryption is mandatory ... Firewall is enabled by default: All incoming traffic by default except for port 22 for ssh and port 53317 for LocalSend.

text: Offers theme matching that restyles supported code editors (VSCode, Cursor, VSCodium, Helix, Zed) to match system theme
quote: We have VSCode, Cursor, Zed, Sublime Text, and Helix listed there. ... Theme matching is offered for VSCode, Cursor, VSCodium, Helix, and Zed.
